quote: We study how instruction following and faithfulness scores change when adapting LMs to two types of datasets: 1) instruction-tuning datasets that are commonly used to train chat-models such as Chat-GPT and Llama-2-Chat ; and 2) context-dependent datasets that require grounding to a provided context, and are commonly used to train Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models such as Atlas and DSPy .

We aim to train LMs to follow human instructions (e.g., answering open-ended questions) while being faithful (e.g., grounding responses in the given context)... we evaluate on extractive QA, abstractive QA and summarization datasets.

We aim to evaluate the model's generation for faithfulness to the given input context. We select a range of context-dependent datasets from three task domains: (1) extractive QA including NQ , BioASQ and SearchQA, taken from the RobustQA benchmark ; (2) abstractive QA with MS MARCO  where the answers are well-formed sentences grounded in context; and (3) abstractive summarization including CNN  and WikiSum .
